transitVisa.badgeLabel: Turkey eVisa or Free Airside Transit
transitVisa.description: Airside transit is 100% FREE without any visa if booked on a through ticket (Turkish Airlines). If self-transferring or exploring the city, Indian passport holders with valid US, UK, or Schengen visas get an instant online eVisa for $50 (~₹4,200).
transitVisa.exemptionNotes: Turkish Airlines offers Touristanbul: 100% free guided Istanbul tour + meals for layovers over 6 hours!

layover.baggageAdvice: If booked as a single Turkish Airlines itinerary, luggage is automatically checked through to São Paulo. For self-transfer split tickets on IndiGo + Turkish, allow 4+ hours to clear Turkish e-Visa immigration and re-check bags.
layover.terminalTransferNotes: All operations are under the single mega-terminal at Istanbul Grand Airport (IST). Very smooth transit flow with clear transfer security checkpoints.

freeStopoverPerks.description: For economy passengers with layover ≥ 20 hours (or business ≥ 9 hours), Turkish Airlines provides up to 2 nights free 4-star hotel stay in Istanbul!

recommendedTimingTips: Optimal layover: 18-36 hours to enjoy a free Istanbul city holiday on your way to Latin America.
Carry a printed copy of your US/UK/Schengen visa to clear Turkish e-Visa border control in under 3 minutes.
Book directly on Turkish Airlines multi-city search to unlock the free hotel perk.

notes: The gold standard route hack for Indians visiting South America. Cuts typical ₹1.2L airfare nearly in half while visiting two world wonders in one vacation.

transitVisa.description: Indian passport holders do NOT require any transit visa in Addis Ababa (ADD) for layovers under 12 hours. For layovers between 8 and 24 hours, Ethiopian Airlines provides a free transit hotel voucher and complimentary transit visa at the transfer desk.
transitVisa.exemptionNotes: Yellow Fever card recommended if leaving the airport into the city, but NOT required for airside transit.

layover.baggageAdvice: Both legs operated seamlessly by Star Alliance member Ethiopian Airlines. Bags are checked all the way from Mumbai to São Paulo.
layover.terminalTransferNotes: Terminal 2 at Bole International Airport (ADD). Transfer security takes 15-20 minutes.

freeStopoverPerks.description: Ethiopian Airlines provides free hotel accommodation + free airport transfer + buffet meals if your transit connection is between 8 and 24 hours!

recommendedTimingTips: Best option for Indian passport holders who DO NOT hold a US or Schengen visa.
Save nearly ₹60,000 compared to legacy carriers routing via Europe.
Choose an 8+ hour layover to sleep in the complimentary Skylight Hotel.

notes: Cheapest legal option to South America for Indian passport holders with zero third-country visa prerequisites.

transitVisa.badgeLabel: 48h Free Transit / 14-day VoA with US Visa
transitVisa.description: 48-hour UAE transit visa is issued free (only ~₹1,200 admin charge) by Emirates. Indian passport holders with US, UK, or Schengen visas get 14-day Visa on Arrival directly at DXB passport control.
transitVisa.exemptionNotes: Airside transit is 100% free without visa for up to 24 hours on through tickets.

layover.baggageAdvice: If booked via Emirates, luggage is through-checked to Brazil. For self-transfer on low-cost carrier legs, allow 3.5+ hours to clear UAE immigration.
layover.terminalTransferNotes: Emirates operates Terminal 3 at DXB. State of the art world hub with 24/7 duty-free and sleeping lounges.

freeStopoverPerks.description: Dubai Stopover package offers deeply discounted 4-star and 5-star desert luxury stays starting at $35/night.

recommendedTimingTips: Fly A380 flagship service directly between Dubai and São Paulo.
Break the 20-hour journey with a 2-day shopping and desert stopover in Dubai.

notes: Premium comfort route hack with unmatched frequency and easy UAE transit access.

transitVisa.description: Airside transit at AUH is visa-free. If self-transferring between IndiGo and Wizz Air, you can get a 48h UAE transit visa online or VoA with US/Schengen visa.

layover.baggageAdvice: Because Leg 2 is on budget carrier Wizz Air/European connector, this is a self-transfer route. Collect baggage at AUH and re-check. Allow minimum 4 hours.
layover.terminalTransferNotes: Zayed International Airport (Terminal A) is ultra-modern with fast-track e-gates.
recommendedTimingTips: Ensure you have a valid Schengen visa prior to departure since Iceland requires Schengen entry.
Travel with cabin luggage only to bypass Abu Dhabi baggage re-check.

notes: The ultra-budget European Arctic hack. Saves over 50% on flights to Iceland.

transitVisa.description: Zero transit visa needed in Addis Ababa on single ticket. Free hotel and meals provided by Ethiopian Airlines for 8-24 hour connections.

layover.baggageAdvice: Through-checked luggage all the way to Buenos Aires (EZE).
layover.terminalTransferNotes: Terminal 2 transit at Bole International Airport.

freeStopoverPerks.description: Complimentary transit hotel in Addis Ababa if layover is between 8 and 24 hours.

recommendedTimingTips: Argentina AVE eVisa holders (with US B2 or Schengen visa) can clear Argentine immigration with zero sticker paperwork.

notes: Avoids complex European transit visa rules while cutting fare by over ₹50,000.

transitVisa.description: If you want to step out, get the instant Vietnam 90-day eVisa online for $25. Perfect for a 2-day Vietnamese culinary break.

layover.baggageAdvice: If booked on VietJet SkyBoss or connected PNR, bags are checked through. For individual promo fares, collect bags and check in again.
recommendedTimingTips: VietJet runs A330 widebody flights between Vietnam and Australia with lie-flat SkyBoss seats at economy prices.

notes: The hottest budget route hack from India to Down Under.

transitVisa.description: Malaysia offers 100% VISA-FREE entry for Indian passport holders (up to 30 days)! Just fill out the free online MDAC digital card 3 days prior.

layover.baggageAdvice: Since Malaysia is completely visa-free for Indians, you can breeze through immigration, pick up luggage at KLIA2, grab lunch at the airport mall, and check in for Japan.
layover.terminalTransferNotes: AirAsia operates at KLIA Terminal 2; full-service airlines at KLIA Terminal 1 (connected via 3-minute train).
recommendedTimingTips: Enjoy a full 24-hour holiday in Kuala Lumpur without paying a single rupee for visas.

notes: Zero visa barrier hub hack to reach Tokyo at half the price.
